platform.name: macOS 14+
platform.previewNotice: Portable HTML/CSS illustrations only; native geometry, focus, keyboard, disabled, selection and motion require actual macOS verification. Preview dimensions are not measured bytes.

extensions.authority: The user authorized a modern minimal floating redesign, superseding v0.3 visual preservation. Read-only global-map scope and UX_SPEC flows remain binding.

motion.name: folder-entry
motion.effect: native backing-content fade; rectangle geometry updates immediately

extensions.motionPolicy: SwiftUI accessibilityReduceMotion and NSWorkspace accessibilityDisplayShouldReduceMotion govern effects; --reduce-motion application override was effective in native fixture. Normal real workflow records effective=false. No tile-size interpolation. Durations are source values; motion timing and every system preference path remain unverified.

nativeLayout.toolbar: 56pt floating; 12pt side and 8pt top inset; 16pt radius
nativeLayout.navigation: History, fit-adaptive breadcrumbs and actual displayed map allocation inside transport
nativeLayout.status: 32pt floating lower shelf; 12pt side and 6pt bottom inset; 12pt radius
nativeLayout.drawer: 360pt overlay; 20pt right, 80pt top, 52pt bottom inset; 18pt radius; 54pt custom tab header; initially closed
nativeLayout.coverage: 480 × 500pt native popover body, 24pt padding; actual visible _NSPopoverWindow content observed at 506 × 526pt
nativeLayout.adaptation: ViewThatFits: full breadcrumbs, ancestor menu plus last segment, then ancestor menu; category key gives way to menu. Same inspector at 960 × 600pt.
nativeLayout.tree: AppKit NSOutlineView; 48pt rows, 1pt gaps, 10pt indentation; 112pt number column; children in 200-record pages; stable viewport sizing with positive scroll/column/bounds fallback prevents reconstruction and depth overflow

mapGeometry.area: Measured allocated bytes; no area invented for zero or unknown
mapGeometry.surface: Single AppKit NSView; 12pt horizontal, 72pt top, 44pt bottom workspace insets
mapGeometry.drawingInset: 2.5pt per edge at short side ≥24pt; 1.5pt at ≥10pt; at most 0.5pt below; underlying allocated rectangles unchanged
mapGeometry.tileRadius: 10pt at painted short side ≥60pt; otherwise min(5pt, short side ×0.18)
mapGeometry.groups: Non-additive boundaries; 1.5pt inset, 12pt radius; chrome fill
mapGeometry.selection: 2pt outline at 95% text; mint when map holds focus
mapGeometry.hover: 1pt outline at 65% text, fill lifted 10% toward text
mapGeometry.mixedFolders: Neutral sRGB 0.19/0.20/0.21, approximately #303336; category fill only for files or rule-backed artifacts

labelThresholds.name: Painted width ≥50pt and height ≥22pt, plus vertical fit
labelThresholds.kind: height >100pt and usable width >115pt plus vertical clearance
labelThresholds.group: width >190pt, height >90pt, area >28000pt²; 28pt annotation; collision omission

mapGeometry.containedSelection: 1pt dashed mint at 85%, 4pt dash/3pt gap on nearest represented real container; explicit Contained in text
mapGeometry.folderEntry: Global bounded hierarchy preview; entered folders compare immediate children. Artifacts/packages remain aggregated until entry.
mapGeometry.rollups: Exact measured allocation and file count, explicitly labeled parent-scoped list
mapGeometry.categoryPerformance: Visible-frontier emphasis resolved from indexed matches; counts and allocation unchanged.

accessibility.canvas: Labeled group directing users to Folders; no per-file canvas accessibility children
accessibility.fallback: Native NSOutlineView selection/expand/collapse with name, kind, size, valid parent share, and path labels; native results list with Inspect/Return and 200-record paging
accessibility.unknown: Direct inaccessible paths without measured allocation say Unknown size, not zero. Partial measured portions, scoped access notes, and valid parent-share denominators stay explicit.

verification.basis: Historical v0.4 fixture workflow plus v0.4.3 saved completed real-global workflow, 56 core tests, native normal/compact access-guide captures and release 0.4.3/build 7 packaging. No post-permission scan.

fixture.note: Explicit temporary completed folder fixture; not the contents of the Mac and not a completed real-global scan. This workflow preceded the coverage-popover capture addition.

real.note: Private machine-specific measurements are excluded from public source; see VERIFICATION.md for validation scope.

mapOccupancy.denominatorNote: Usable content excludes the 32pt native title-bar region. Opening the panel does not resize the map.

notAsserted: Every system Reduce Motion preference path

historicalEvidence.note: Historical values do not describe the current snapshot or certify the v0.4 surfaces.

verification.rasterAssets: No raster artwork ships; actual native captures are verification evidence only.

scanActivityUpdate.basis: Native CUA inspection of real global scanning at normal and compact width; isolated fixture reduced-motion, stop, cancellation and completion checks; release packaging, signature and plists.

invariants: Allocated, logical, volume capacity and recoverable space are distinct
No invented area for zero or unknown

accessGuidance.notice: Allow Atlas to read your storage; Set up access opens the first-viewport permission guide. Access is used only to read file information and measure sizes; no changes/deletions.
accessGuidance.trigger: Only current read denial; no request for readable, unknown, checking or historical scope notes
accessGuidance.persistence: App UserDefaults stores last observation and dismissal; launch/activation rechecks actual access

indexMaintenance.completion: Atomic snapshot commit; retention runs after endScan

components.name: Floating transport
components.description: 56pt transport with Atlas mark/name, history, breadcrumb/actual allocation, scoped search, named Folders and panel/refresh controls. 16pt radius and one neutral offset shadow.

components.name: Neutral native action
components.description: 32pt minimum transport action. Neutral field hover/active, 10pt radius and labeled SF Symbol; disabled opacity 35%.

components.name: Indexed-path search
components.description: 208 × 34pt native field with scoped menu, 180ms debounce, conditional clear/progress and Return to Results.

components.name: Map navigation
components.description: Back/Forward/Up and fit-adaptive ancestor breadcrumbs share the transport; On disk (or Folder snapshot) reports measured allocation, explicit measured zero or Unknown size where appropriate.

components.name: Floating filter/status shelf
components.description: 32pt lower shelf shows native indeterminate scan activity with actual file/allocation counters while scanning, a stationary marker for Reduce Motion or stopping, and a compact category menu plus separate free bytes. Idle status/freshness return when the scan ends.

components.name: Category highlight
components.description: 11pt labels and 6pt circular category marks; neutral active field. Focused-folder measured totals/percentages, with legacy Models disabled.

components.name: Measured tile
components.description: Exact allocated layout region with bounded rounded painting and 5pt large-neighbor seams. 11/13/18pt names and 11/18/26pt size figures appear only when they fit.

components.name: Folder annotation
components.description: 28pt non-additive floating label, collision omitted; native 12pt name and 11pt size with small offset shadow.

components.name: Optional floating inspector
components.description: 360pt optional overlay, 18pt corners and one offset shadow. 54pt header with custom neutral Folders/Results/Details tabs and close action. Opening preserves map geometry.

components.name: Native indexed Results
components.description: 44pt minimum row content plus 4pt vertical insets, 12pt names/values and 11pt paths. Neutral selection; explicit loading/empty state, scope, count, paging and actions.

components.name: Native lazy folder tree
components.description: NSOutlineView with 48pt rows, 10pt indentation, 13pt names and 11pt metadata/numbers; 112pt numeric column. Native keyboard and disclosure remain; custom neutral selection/hover. Stable viewport sizing and actual native deep/compact share-frame containment checks pass after panel reconstruction.

components.name: Measurement details
components.description: 22pt selectable item title, 11pt full monospaced path, 30pt allocated figure, distinct logical/date rows, exact scoped composition bars and recognition evidence.

components.name: Coverage and unknown states
components.description: Native 480 × 500pt body with 24pt padding; actual 506 × 526pt visible popover captured. 20pt heading, 28pt measured figure, distinct volume rows, 13pt section headings and explicit allocation/recovery/access limits.

components.name: Native application icon
components.description: Existing mint/neutral Atlas three-block mark on the dark rounded panel square; SVG master, native 16–1024px iconset and packaged AppIcon.icns. Finder icon/list views verified; the versioned build takes effect on next launch.

narrative.northStar: The storage map is the workspace
narrative.overview: A continuous near-black measured field beneath floating neutral navigation, filter and inspection instruments. The user-authorized v0.4 redesign replaces v0.3 visual preservation while retaining global-map, read-only and UX_SPEC behavior. Native SF typography, AppKit outline/menus and exact allocated geometry remain authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: One proportional map; no permanent sidebar or dashboard
Aligned floating neutral surfaces with one offset shadow
Larger direct map labels and distinct allocated measurements
Stable geometry through emphasis and inspection
Visible partial coverage, freshness and unknowns

rules.name: Stable denominator
rules.body: Selection, category emphasis, search and opening the inspector never repartition or resize the measured map.

dos: Keep the map dominant and auxiliary panels optional
Use actual bytes/counts and explicit denominators
Preserve native keyboard, selection and lazy scrolling
Keep zero, unknown, partial and legacy states explicit
Verify native normal and compact layout before claiming completion
donts: Restore a permanent five-destination sidebar or marketing header
Put category color on actions or infer cleanup safety
Interpolate measured rectangle size during navigation
Treat browser previews or source wiring as native runtime proof
